description: Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) states President Trump "wants a Fed that acts like a sock puppet for him," when discussing her thoughts on the President's Fed chair nominee Kevin Warsh. She also talks about what changes & restrictions she wants from ICE as the Senate is set to vote on the latest government funding bill. Senator Warren speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Kevin Warsh Passes Trump's Sock Puppet Test: Sen. Warren

author: Andreina Itriago
description: Venezuela’s interim government announced broad amnesty for political prisoners on Friday, a move that could benefit hundreds of people still held in the country’s jails, local news outlet EFE reported, citing comments from acting President Delcy Rodríguez.
title: Venezuela’s Rodriguez Announces Amnesty For Political Prisoners

description: Brazil Finance Minister Fernando Haddad has pitched President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on naming an ally from inside his ministry to an open seat on the central bank board, according to two people with knowledge of the situation.
title: Brazil’s Haddad Pitches Ministry Ally for Open Central Bank Seat

author: Patpicha Tanakasempipat
description: The People’s Party, which rose from the ashes of the group that won Thailand’s 2023 election only to be blocked from power, may need a landslide victory to avoid a similar fate in Feb. 8 polls.
title: Popular Thai Reformists Face Being Blocked From Power Once More

description: SpaceX is considering a potential merger with Tesla, as well as an alternative combination with artificial intelligence firm xAI, according to people familiar with the matter, a sign billionaire Elon Musk is weighing how to consolidate his empire. The firm has discussed the feasibility of a tie-up between SpaceX and Tesla, an idea that some investors are pushing, the people said, asking not to be identified as the information isn’t public. Separately, they are also exploring a tie-up between SpaceX and xAI ahead of an IPO, some of the people said. Any transaction could attract sizeable interest from infrastructure funds and Middle Eastern sovereign investors, some of the people said. A deal could also potentially require a large financing component, one of them said. Bloomberg Tech Co-Host Ed Ludlow joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. He speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Said to Consider Merger With Tesla or xAI

description: Donald Trump named Kevin Warsh to be the next chair of the Federal Reserve, ending months of speculation over who’d take charge of US interest rates as the president pushes for big cuts. “I have known Kevin for a long period of time, and have no doubt that he will go down as one of the GREAT Fed Chairmen, maybe the best,” Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform. “On top of everything else, he is ‘central casting,’ and he will never let you down.” Bloomberg TV and Radio International Economics & Policy Correspondent Michael McKee and Katy Kaminski, Chief Research Strategist and Portfolio Manager at AlphaSimplex Group, join Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. They speak with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Taps 'Whole Package' Kevin Warsh From 'Central Casting' For Fed Chair

author: Alex Wickham
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping told Keir Starmer he wanted a “long-term, stable” relationship with Britain. Those are things the UK prime minster cannot guarantee.

title: Andreessen, Horowitz Fuel AI Industry’s $51 Million Midterm Haul

description:
On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss President Trump picking former Federal Reserve Governor Kevin Warsh as the next Federal Reserve Chairman.
Bloomberg's Mike McKee weighs in on Warsh's background, and Katy Kaminski of AlphaSimplex discusses market reaction to Warsh. Then, VanEck CEO Jan van Eck weighs in on the metals market as gold and silver plunge in a stark reversal after a recent rally. Also, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman weighs in on Apple earnings, and Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow discusses Elon Musk's SpaceX reportedly considering a merger with Tesla or xAI. Finally, Aon CFO Edmund Reese joins to discuss the company's latest earnings results and the state of the insurance market. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Taps Warsh From 'Central Casting' For Fed | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 1/30/2026

description: Chair of the House Financial Services Committee French Hill said that he hopes the DOJ can review data and make a decision about whether to pursue a further investigation of Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell before it impacts President Trump's economic agenda, including the confirmation of Kevin Warsh as the next fed chair. The Republican representative from Arkansas also said that he expects Powell to appear before his committee for his semi-annual testimony, something that had been up in the air given the DOJ's investigation.  (Source: Bloomberg)

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

On today's show, the Trump administration is preparing for the president to nominate Kevin Warsh to be the next Federal Reserve chair, according to people familiar with the matter. President Trump said Thursday he plans to announce his pick to lead the US central bank on Friday morning.

Apple delivered record quarterly sales and a better-than-anticipated forecast for the current period, even as the company warned that rising component costs are threatening to squeeze margins. 

Today's guest: Maria Martisiute, European Policy Centre Policy Analyst. (Source: Bloomberg)
